property_summary: If transfer returns (does not revert), it must return true and leave c.from and c.caddress unchanged; also transfer requires non-empty _tos so it must revert when _tos.length == 0.
If transfer returns (does not revert) when called with non-empty _tos and matching lengths, it must return true.
When transfer reverts it must be because msg.sender is not the stored from address (i.e., if caller equals c.from then transfer cannot revert under matching non-empty equal-length inputs).
